fusions.name: Counted Arrows
fusions.desc: Shoots a target up to 9 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Between Heartbeats
fusions.desc: Takes 1.5 seconds to draw, then looses an arrow that flies up to 12 tiles and hits the first enemy in its path for 32 damage, ignoring its armour.

fusions.name: Full Draw
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to settle your aim, then increases your damage by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Ranging Shots
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes it for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
